IF
GameBookInterfaceClosed(S_GOB_SharTempleMap_f01b15a1-e670-43ac-abeb-e7ec9d5fc803,_Char)
AND
DB_Players(_Char)
AND
DB_QuestIsAccepted("SHA_Nightsong")
AND
QuestUpdateIsUnlocked(_Char, "SHA_Nightsong", "SawBook", 0)
THEN
QuestUpdate(_Char, "SHA_Nightsong", "RefinedLocation");

IF
UseStarted(_Player, S_FOR_DoctorLog_bd7b6fad-8409-4d5d-bd8b-824c93412165)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("FOR_ThayanCellar_ReadLog")
THEN
SetFlag((FLAG)FOR_ThayanCellar_Quest_ReadDoctorLog_db3f8b4a-87f4-4732-abd1-9de54fd58a6a, NULL_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, 0);

PROC
PROC_END_Courtyard_DragonFlyBy(_, _)
AND
DB_Players(_AnyPlayer)
AND
IsInInventoryOf((ITEM)S_GLO_GithRadar_4aca442e-5ecb-4611-b481-5eaf35596dea, _AnyPlayer, 1)
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("END_Courtyard_RadarActivated")
THEN
PlaySound(_AnyPlayer, "SE_Pendulum_Psionic_Detector");

IF
AddedTo(_Book, _Player, _)
AND
DB_Players((CHARACTER)_Player)
AND
Exists(_Book, 1)
AND
IsTagged(_Book, (TAG)BOOK_8a8e253a-c081-45a1-9fa2-91b6901dc568, 1)
AND
IsTagged(_Book, (TAG)SCROLL_dd86c045-0370-4ec9-b7c5-b0b160706f09, 0)
AND
NOT GetTemplate(_Book, UNI_S_DebugBook_31ee023c-d151-40f6-917e-84066772783b)
THEN
PROC_ShowUnifiedTutorialForPlayer((CHARACTER)_Player, (UNIFIEDTUTORIAL)Books_e9297013-6a19-4c86-9f35-1cfd4edddb5b);
